lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003e[Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ ocupa la:
"

[Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ occupies the same six positions but with independent ligands: it is achiral (Oh). When the N are joined in pairs by bridges, chirality appears (D₃).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eAl torcer el triángul:
"

When the back triangle is twisted from −60° to 0°, a trigonal prism with a σh plane appears: it is achiral. Continuing to +60° gives the mirror image. The helicity plot crosses zero at 0°.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl modelo izquierdo s:
"

The left model is reflected through a mirror plane. At 100 % you get the other enantiomer. The guide helix shows the sense of the twist of the chelates.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn \u003cb\u003e[Co(e:
"

In [Co(en)₃]³⁺ each band joins the two N of the same ethylenediamine: the two N occupy cis positions (≈90°). That connectivity is the information that gives the complex its chirality.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eRegla de la mano: pul:
"

Hand rule: right thumb along the C₃ axis. If the chelates turn like the right fingers, it is Δ; if not, Λ. Use “Hint: look along the axis” if you need it.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSe prueban las \u003c:
"

The 24 proper rotations of the octahedron are tested. Matching the N is not enough: the connections between them must also match. Δ and Λ never manage to coincide completely.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSe resalta el ligando:
"

Ligand 1 is highlighted. The three ligands are identical: the colors only help to follow them in the model.

"
lit.\u0027Arrastra los modelos para girarlos: "Drag the models to rotate them, use the wheel to zoom and the numbered buttons (1–6) to change module. The guided lesson (book button, or the L key) goes through the six modules."
lit.\u0027convierte Δ en Λ con un plano de e: "converts Δ into Λ with a mirror plane."
lit.\u0027El camino Δ ⇄ Λ pasa por un prisma: "The Δ ⇄ Λ path goes through an achiral prism"
lit.\u0027identifica Δ o Λ en orientaciones: "identify Δ or Λ in random orientations."
lit.\u0027las 24 rotaciones propias del octa: "the 24 proper rotations of the octahedron; the histogram shows how many N coincide."
lit.\u0027torsión continua; la gráfica de he: "continuous twist; the helicity plot crosses zero at the achiral prism."
